Daily Chess Puzzles

A two-year daily chess training plan: 4,015 curated Lichess puzzles that ramp from easy to very difficult, with a streak calendar tied to your Chess Coach name.
Loading…
Days completed: 0 / 730 Streak: 0

One set of puzzles per day for two years, ramping from easy to very difficult. Early days serve ten quick puzzles; the final days serve a single monster. Skipped days are never lost. Your next unsolved set always waits for you, and the calendar turns green on each day you finish a set. Puzzles are drawn from the Lichess puzzle database (CC0), curated for quality, with trivial one-movers excluded. Your progress follows the name you joined the Chess Coach leaderboard with, or stays in this browser if you have not joined.
